128134.description:
It was the Meiji era. One day, Hanashiro Saori, the daughter of a viscount family who was trained in both kendo and judo despite being a girl, tasted the western-style cuisine made by Chef Kusabayashi Kanji during a short course he gave. Kusabayashi was the owner of famed western-style restaurant “Jiyuuken” and had a motto of “Cheap yet delicious”. Rendered speechless from the deliciousness of what she tasted, Saori came before the doors of “Jiyuuken” with the aspiration of opening her own restaurant where “everyone is smiling from the good food.” Kanji was not one to accept disciples, but moved by her passion and zealousness, as well as her talent of being able to recreate any dish from taste, he took her in as an exception. Saori’s harsh but fulfilling days of training had begun—but, when her classmate Saionji Misa, the daughter of a court noble, saw her, she disapproved of her actions as a member of nobility…!?

(Source: LINE, translated)

Her hairstyle and clothing are different, but could it be that… she’s the woman living next door who I have a crush on!? But, how can we marry with this age gap! Even so, we began to date (tentatively)… “Pass me your keys. I’ll go make a duplicate.” “Huh!” Whether day or night, she barges in my apartment from next door, and flirts with me relentlessly in school whenever there’s a chance to! Suah is a petite, red-haired designer who leads a drama-free life… until one morning, she wakes up tied to a chair. The man scowling down at her is none other than her roommate’s scary older brother, Seung-hyun, the owner of the apartment she’s been living in rent-free for the past eight years. He gives her one week to pack her bags and move out. Panicked Suah tries to plead and beg, but the coldhearted Seung-hyun’s got the upper hand. That is, until he runs into Suah at work. Turns out she’s not only an essential member of the new team he put together, but also one of the best employees he’s ever worked with. Like it or not, the two are stuck with each other for the foreseeable future… Can Suah convince Seung-hyun to let her stay? The strongest wizard Alfred, in a hero’s party, subdued the Maou and in the process took a cursed arrow to the knee. Even with the hurt knee, Alfred’s still the strongest wizard ever.

"We need a chief for our newly created knight squad!"
"Could you help us as our guild manager?"
"We need someone to rid us of the dragon that resides in the North Mountain."

Alfred just wanted some time to rest and recover, but no one would LEAVE HIM ALONE. Because of that, Alfred wished to spend time recovering in a small country village that no one knew about.

"Need a guard in Mulg Village. Wolves and boars attacking the village. Payment is food and board. *Village has a hot spring."
So, the strongest wizard in the kingdom decided on living the slow life in the country

128174.description:
"Ina Yoo, an average girl from earth gets summoned to a fantasy world called Elysion where only males with magical powers exist and. Elysion summons females from other worlds and the men of Elysion treat the women with the utmost respect and try to charm the women to be selected as their husbands and mating partners. When the men of Elysion mate with the women, mana from the men are passed on to the women, and depending on the mana capacity of the person, the women can use this mana as their own power.

Ina is courted by many men of the top hierarchy of Elysion population and her choice of husband affects her political powers in Elysion as well as magical powers. Ina is naturally able to receive much mana from the men, which is a great point of attraction for men, especially in positions of social power and influence.

As Ina rises in social-political status with her increasing magical powers, a rival, Roxanne, appears and tries to overthrow Ina's influence in Elysion by creating riots. Ina now has to calm the riots but can she do so through her husbands and boyfriends...?"

Struggling through emotions like deep regret and sorrow... she wanders aimlessly, not knowing what to do with her life now. Meanwhile, time has frozen for Mr. Tsuda's son, Ritsu, as well... as the grief of losing his only living immediate family washes unforgivingly over him. Things start changing when the two meet, but little do they know what fate has in store for them...

(Source: Renta!)

128177.description: A former police inspector turned taxi driver, Yajima leads a double life. By day he walks his clients around in hopes of raising enough money to cover his daughter, Maiko's hospital costs, and at night he dons the mask of the professional assassin. Cold and calculating, Yajima goes on to contract. But not just for the purpose of providing for her daughter. Through blood and violence, he also seems to be freeing himself from his rage towards the world. Sex, lies and brutality reign supreme in the city which sees the wings of this new demon unfold before its eyes.

Weed's children have been sent away for training, and are oblivious to the crisis at hand. Can the soldiers of Ouu defeat this new take on an old threat? Or is this truly be to their last fight?

128188.description:
Gin, Weed, and their children, the brothers Orion and Sirius. The legend of Ginga continues to be passed down... Sirius lost his life in a fierce battle with Monsoon, a mad bear of the red beetle bloodline that attacked Oshu, a paradise for dogs. Orion, unable to fully understand Sirius' ideal of being able to understand any enemy, was unable to accept the shock of losing Sirius and disappeared. And so Orion's journey of wandering begins. What kind of dog (thing) will Orion meet on his journey...? The latest chapter of the Ginga Legend series begins!!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

128189.description:
The hit manga adaptation of the 2021 movie of the same name, The Great Yokai War: Guardians is the epic adventure of Watanabe, a seemingly ordinary student who inherits the power of a legendary monster hunter, to defeat the monstrous yokai rampaging towards Tokyo!

After ancient fossils are disturbed by an earthquake in Japan, the spirits of evil yokai manifest as gigantic monsters, rampaging towards Tokyo! The only person who can stop it is young elementary school student Watanabe who is the unknowing descendant of a long line of legendary monster hunters!

(Source: Titan Manga)

title.native: 妖怪大戦争 ガーディアンズ

128191.description:
The new school year brings with it a myriad of new encounters. Han-Seok’s first meeting with Ki-Un involves snow, an obese calico cat, and a lingering sweet scent. As it turns out, the two are now classmates, and Han-Seok finds himself slowly drawn to Ki-Un. Han-Seok wants to grow closer to Ki-Un, but he proves to be a tough nut to crack. He's amiable enough, but Ki-Un soon senses an invisible wall between him and his target. Will Han-Seok manage to charm his way through to Ki-Un's heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

128192.description:
A man with the ability to hear inner voices got married to a girl who can't speak.

It's the Taisho era. Kyogoku Kazunari, who can hear people's inner voices, makes skillful use of his ability by running a trading company. His business is going well, but due to his power, he cannot trust others and has been quite bitter so far.

Wanting to make use of their connections, Kazunari has proposed to marry the daughter of the noble Suwabe family. However, not only can he not hear the inner voice of his partner Suwabe Nana, but she is also unable to speak. While Kazunari is bewildered, the two of them get married on the spur of the moment...? A clumsy but happy married life begins for them.

128193.description: Aida is a man with a decent appearance who fell in love with the class idol Yano Kokoro and changed his seat in class to get closer to her. He studied shoujo manga which (as he claims) all girls on the planet love and tries to use that knowledge to win over her heart. However, Yano is a realistic girl who doesn't seem to be too fond of that approach...

title.native: ラブコメディはお嫌いですか？
title.romaji: Love Comedy wa Okirai desu ka?

synonyms: You and I are Polar Opposites

128195.description: The youngest princess of the country of Stellaus, Marietta, was betrothed in a political marriage to the General of the great militant country, Oltaire. General Belvant was often said to be strong, a fierce and terrifying god of a warrior. On the other hand, Marietta was a delicate flower of a princess. Everyone felt pity for poor Marietta’s situation, however, the truth was that Marietta found the General very dreamy… The story of a 30-year old General with a scary face (who was actually quite nice), and the tiny and adorable 18-year old Princess in their times of conflict and of lovey-doveyness.
synonyms: Princess Marietta’s Wedding ~Her Husband is Too Dreamy!~

title.native: マリエッタ姫の婚礼～旦那様、素敵すぎます！～
title.romaji: Marietta-hime no Konrei: Danna-sama, Suteki Sugimasu!

title.native: 波原さんはぶちまけたい！

128198.description:
The popular boy band seems peaceful, but the members had already broken up with each other privately. After an accident, the members traveled back to ten years ago when they just made their debut. Being given a second chance, how much effort does he need to spend to save his relationship with Meng Yilan and other members? This is a story about dreams and love!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: おはよう、愚か者。おやすみ、ボクの世界
title.romaji: Ohayou, Orokamono. Oyasumi, Boku no Sekai

128200.description:
The very popular omega model, Masatsugu Otonashi, hates alphas on a totally different level. However, one day, Otonashi is assigned an assistant, Mei Todoroki, an alpha who ends up being at the mercy of his unreasonable demands. Despite the hardships of being Otonashi's assistant, Todoroki flawlessly does his job and eventually gains Otonashi's trust...and Todoroki soon becomes drawn to Otonashi's vulnerability and kindness...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 俺だけの専属アルファ

128201.description:
Collection of Harukawa Haru's work, including newly-drawn versions of some of her old oneshots and a special never-before-released version of "Touka-san wa Kaji ga Dekinai".

1. Anata no Yoru ga Aketara (あなたの夜が明けたら, After Sunrise)
2. Anata no Yoru ga Aketara (New) (あなたの夜が明けたら 描き下ろし, After Sunrise (New)
3. Masking Lady (マスキングレディ)
4. Whenever Our Eyes Meet (あの娘と目が合うたび私は, Ano Musume to Me ga Au Tabi Watashi wa)
5. Lose Control (ルーズコントロール)
6. Lose Control 4-Koma (ルーズコントロール 四コマ)
7. Pink Strawberry (ピンク・ストロベリー)
8. Chocolat de Bonheur (ショコラ・ド・ボヌール)
9. Itsusunsaki wa Moto Kano (一寸先は元カノ, One Step Ahead Ex-Girlfriend)
10. Touka-san wa Kaji ga Dekinai: Original (1) (塔子さんは家事ができない。 オリジナル (1))
11. Touka-san wa Kaji ga Dekinai: Original (2) (塔子さんは家事ができない。 オリジナル (2))
12. Ikenai to Wakatte iru (いけないとわかっている, I Know I Shouldn't)
13. Kyuuketsuki (吸血鬼, Vampire)
14. Toshi no Sa (年の差, Year-Difference)
15. Kimi o Mitasu made (君を満たすまで, Until You Are Satisfied)

title.native: あなたの夜が明けたら

128202.description: Masumura weaves a fantasy series about a boy named Shouta, who meets a strange cat with an even stranger ability to control minerals. Shortly after, he comes across a legendary crystal city that his brought forth by the thoughts and wishes of those who create it.

128203.description: Shishio who was an omega living in the low class of society was picked up by Masami, an alpha who gives him a place in the yakuza society. "I want to become your mate, Masami." He used to live every day fighting his strong omega instincts, but...?!

128204.description:
Due to something that happened when he was younger, Yuji Kuga is anthrophobic and has no experience with women. The only person who can touch him is Leo, the childhood friend who has always looked out for him. Deciding that he can't trouble Leo any more than he already has, Yuji tries to get over his trauma at college, to no avail. In fact, even his twin brother, Reiji, tells him enough is enough. Then, one night, Yuji is surrounded by gay men and dragged to a literal "hole in the wall" bar; an establishment where the male staff service customers by offering their lower body through a hole in a wall. It turns out that Yuji was mistaken for Reiji, who works there part-time. He's required to pleasure customers without any explanation, but for some reason, rather than hating it, he revels in the satisfaction the unknown man on the other side of the wall brings him again and again. For the first time, Yuji experiences the delights of someone else's fingers and tongue. He starts thinking that doing this might just help him overcome his phobia... And he can't forget the ecstasy he felt while he was being thrust into. So, the next day, he heads to the bar once more...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 壁に穴あり双子でチェリー
title.romaji: Kabe ni Ana Ari Futago de Cherry

128205.description:
Tanaka Koutarou, a taxi driver who works in the countryside, loves his uneventful life more than anything. One day, he ends up saving a yakuza, Kurokawa Hozumi, whose abdomen was bleeding. A few weeks later, under the guise of attempting to return the favour, Hozumi pins Koutarou down...
"I’ll do my best to entertain you."

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Doutei no Ore wo Oshitaoshita no wa Osananajimi deshita".
synonyms: The Yakuza I Rescued Has His Eyes on Me?!

title.native: 助けたヤクザに狙われてます?

128206.description:
In a world evolved from cats, both males and females can give birth. Raised in an orphanage, Kazui (mixed breed) has always had a strong desire for a family of his own. He doesn't need a baby daddy, just children of his own flesh and blood. He wanders the streets looking for someone to plant their seed in him.

One day, his boss sets him up with a new job as manager for a popular model, Noah (purebred). Kazui starts feeling comfortable around the ever-doting Noah, and fantasizes about being happy having more than just kids with him...

Along with the cover story about a hot model and his lonely, starving-for-love manager, this comic is filled with love stories between cat men, including a mixed-breed model who's a sore loser and his much older, talented-yet-punishing manager, and a boss and his shallow subordinate who are dynamite in bed together!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 好物はいちばんさいごに腹のなか
title.romaji: Koubutsu wa Ichiban Saigo ni Hara no Naka

128208.description: Toraji is the leader of the delinquents group enrolled in a certain school. That technical high school, full of Yankees, is divided into two gangs, “Toraji gang” and “Ryuuichi gang”, and they fight ruthlessly day after day. Today too, an one-on-one fight was arranged to decide who’s gonna be the real leader, but… Suddenly, Toraji’s father decided to come out and announced that he just re-married. After a brief moment of shock, Toraji realized his father’s partner’s son is his opponent, Ryuuichi…?! Now the two rivals end up under one roof… Who’s gonna be who?

128209.description: Densuke Konomiya is a powerful exorcist, hunted down by numerous Magical Beings who hope to drink his blood and gain immense power. He can normally get rid of them without much effort, until he meets one who won't give up no matter how many times he's beaten down. Instead of fighting him again and again, Densuke decides to make the pest his familiar instead.

title.native: 神様のおかげ、でしたっ

128212.description:
Weird development where the main character, who is the fourth son of a noble household and is called the stain of nobility, has to inherit the house because his three brothers were conveniently in the same party and all died to a meteorite apparently. The older sister who's left disowns herself and instead registers herself as his foster daughter and now she calls him dad all to get him to head the house and have him demonstrate his true ability.

Note: Includes a prologue, and six bonus chapters

title.romaji: Ore wa Mada, Honki wo Dashite Inai

The older sister who's left disowns herself and instead registers herself as his foster daughter and now she calls him dad all to get him to head the house and have him demonstrate his true ability.

128214.description: After being fired, high school student Shirono Akifumi happens upon "Rental Hoodlums," a service that might be the job he's best suited for.

128216.description:
Window of food 's level starting to pop up in Minjoon's sight! Minjoon's journey to becoming the best chef!

(Source: Lalatoon)

128217.description:
By anyone’s standards, Minhyeok is a good egg: he’s a reliable coworker, a faithful fiancé… a real stand up guy! The future looks rosy until one day he’s unceremoniously dumped by his future wife. As his dreams of domestic bliss go up in flames, Minhyeok goes off the rails. Strange thing is, his new devil-may-care attitude goes down extremely well with the ladies. And there are plenty of stunners around him who have been biding their time, waiting to pounce. Soon enough, Minhyeok learns that when the chips are down, you gotta rise to the occasion!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ドン底でモテ期〜マジメくんの性事情〜

128218.description:
In this reverse harem isekai romance, a young woman named Mashiro is reborn in a fantasy world inhabited only by men–and suddenly finds herself with four supernatural suitors! These handsome men with fur, feathers, and horns call themselves gods. She’s now the sole human female in their world, so they all want her to bear their children. As if that’s not enough, the air of this new realm is permeated with a poison that only a god can suppress…with a kiss.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: 失格新娘ー異系婚姻ー

title.native: アウトブライド-異系婚姻-

128219.description: Natsumi is desperate to meet a girl and do something about his adolescent desires. Unfortunately, attending an all-boys school limits his opportunities. That is, until he meets the new intern doctor, Mr. Annou. Instantly attracted to his beautiful features and black hair, all Natsumi can think about is making love to him! Is this physical attraction, or is it love? Whichever it is, he wants to hook up!

title.english: Going Through Puberty -I Want to Hook Up with You!-
title.native: 思春期だから。～安藤先生とSEXしたいんです！
title.romaji: Shishunki Dakara Andou-Sensei to Sex Shitaindesu!

128220.description:
I was Eun-Ho Sun’s biggest fan… And I never should’ve let her meet my boyfriend. I thanked my lucky stars when this mysterious author granted me the only interview she’d ever given in her illustrious career. She shared intense, off-the-record secrets with me. I even thought we could be friends. At first, it seemed like an invitation to her home would solidify our friendship, but she wound up in bed with my boyfriend. Will the woman I once idolized actually steal away the love of my life?!

(Source: Tapas)

128221.description:
For Elan the royal knight, the masquerade festival is a rare chance to let loose and relax. But her night of fun quickly turns into a morning of horror when she wakes up beside the ruthless Emperor Kylart. Knowing how cruel he can be to clingy women, Elan makes a run for it, hoping he hasn't seen past her disguise. But as she continues her nerve-wracking duties of guarding the emperor, she starts experiencing troubling health symptoms. A trip to the doctor reveals that she's pregnant! To make matters worse, rumor has it that Kylart is looking for the mysterious woman he met on the night of the festival. Can Elan keep her secret safe from the entire palace, when she can't even control her constant cravings and morning sickness?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Gave Birth to the Tyrant's Child

title.english: I Got Pregnant with the Tyrant's Child

128222.description:
In an age where everyone pursues extremely skinny figures for the sake of beauty, Lu Xiaorun—who is slightly chubby—has to face many difficulties. But one day, by chance, she travels back in time to the Tang dynasty. What kind of encounters will she have in a world where plump is beautiful? Will an otaku fujoshi like her be considered a weirdo in the ancient times she finds herself in? The thrilling and hilarious story of a chubby girl’s transformation... starts now!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Back to the Tang Dynasty: The Chubby Beauty
title.romaji: Pang Hui Da Tang Dang Nüshen

128224.description: In this era, demons and monsters roam the streets at night. Humans and familiars work as partners who kill those monsters. Civil servant Fan Xiaotie and the strongest demon girl Linyu of the secret department “Supernatural Affairs Armed Response Team” must face an endless crisis.

128225.description:
1. Ippai Mawaso! Aru Hi no Koto. (いっぱいまわそ！ ある日のコト。, Let's Do It A Lot! A Certain Day's Events); Comic LO 2018-09
2. Ippai Mawaso! (いっぱいまわそ！, Let's keep rolling!); Comic LO 2018-03
3. Ippai Mawaso! Atarukana? (いっぱいまわそ！ あたるかな？, Let's raise the stakes! Will I hit a jackpot?); Comic LO 2018-06
4. Girls Meet TT (がーるみーつTT); Comic LO 2018-01
5-6. Choi Ero Dakara (ちょいエロだから, Just a bit Lewd); Comic LO 2016-04, 09
7-9. 1 Pair (1Pair 第1話); Comic LO 2015-04, 07, 12
10. Kanezuru or...? (金ヅルor…？, After Money Or...?); Comic LO 2014-11
synonyms: Ippai Mawaso! Aru Hi no Koto.
Let's Do It A Lot! A Certain Day's Events
Let's raise the stakes! Will I hit a jackpot?

128226.description:
In the eye of the brother, the young sister is a hassle, but eventually, he became a sister - con.

In the eye of the sister, the image of the older brother was a respectful figure, but soon degenerates into something worse, she thinks her brother is a big idiot.

A pair of siblings, two pairs of childhood friends, acting the love-hate relationship and trying to do each other in slapstick comedy, all for your enjoyment and fulfillment.
synonyms: My Brother Is a Big Idiot!

128227.description: Yahiro confesses his feelings to his old classmate,the handsome and stylish Itsuki,when they reunite after many years. Itsuki is surprised,but intrigued by Yahiro's confession,especially when Yahiro says "I'll do anything you want me to do". With this confession in his back pocket,Itsuki decides to see how far he can push Yahiro with the things he asks him to do. Itsuki asks Yahiro to meet him at a train station to touch and tease him on the packed train. Expecting to see a panicked look on Yahiro's face,Itsuki is surprised when he sees Yahiro enjoying the thrill. What started as Itsuki just wanting to have some fun seems to be turning into more than what he intended.

title.english: Let Me Tease You -Submit to Your Reward-
title.native: 先輩、イジメてあげますね～ドSな後輩のご褒美調教
title.romaji: Senpai, Ijimete Agemasu ne Do-S na Kouhai no Gohoubi Choukyou

128228.description:
"If you can't change my mind in three months... die with me."

Saku, a college student, hears news that the orphanage he grew up in going out of operation. He goes to the president of the company purchasing the orphanage to negotiate with him directly. The president agrees to rethink the deal under one condition... that being "meet my son and change his mind"!? Leo, his son, is smart and handsome but has a pretty troubled personality... Saku is instantly picked on and rough-handled... Where will this life-risking (?) negotiation between the worst opponent imaginable go?

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

128229.description:
Meeting people wears me out. I'm afraid to speak my mind. I don't know express my anger. I can’t sleep…
This book explores how to cope with a life's difficulties that makes it feel so hard just to live.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

128230.description:
A listless Demon Queen falls in love with a human. After breaking a treaty and waging war against the demons, humanity suffered a crushing defeat. Civilization has been destroyed, and demons are now the ruling species. At the very top, above all others, is the Demon Queen. But the Demon Queen is tired. In fact, she only has one wish: to die!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: The Demon Lord Wants to Die

title.english: The Demon Queen Has a Death Wish

title.romaji: Shikkoku Shoujo to Shiro no Doukei

128232.description:
The marriage arrangement introduced to the duke’s daughter, Hermina, had been to the rumoured worst playboy in high society, the Earl’s son, Erich. Hermina, who accepted the offer, sends him a letter with conditions for their married life. The letter had nothing but unreasonable demands, but Erich says that he’s happy and that he’s looking forward to their married life…!?

"I’ll become Hermina-sama’s dog or manservant for the rest of my life." - What is this guy saying!?

Isn’t this just fluff between a beautiful intense wife and a con-man husband? A newly-wed love comedy.

128233.description:
By some ill fortune, Hikaru died in a traffic accident. He was in heaven standing in line, waiting to be judged, when he took an unexpected request to transfer his soul into a person in another world. He received an ability called Soul Board which he could use to allocate points to Skills to make himself more powerful. But there was a catch…

"I want you to take revenge on someone for me within an hour. If you don’t, I’ll destroy your soul."

To pull off the task assigned to him, he poured all his available points to the Stealth skill tree. This is a story of a boy who specialised in Stealth. With his skill trees as weapons, he would demonstrate his unrivalled strength in another world.
synonyms: The Undetectable Strongest Job: Rule Breaker

title.native: 察知されない最強職 (ルール・ブレイカー)

128234.description:
The Edo period has ended, and former samurai Haruyasu is adrift in a strange new world. Not even the promise of rebellion can cure him of his desire for death. But after an assassination gone wrong, Haruyasu finds himself at the mercy of his intended victim’s bodyguard, an intriguing young woman with the power to heal–so intriguing, in fact, that he decides he wants to live in order to learn more about her. But what will she ask in return for saving his life?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Those With Courage, Come and Lay Down Your Lives

title.native: 勇気あるものより散れ
先日助けて頂いた〇〇です！

128240.description:
After Keyaru was treated like a tool for many years, he promised himself to take revenge on the heroes that treated him so badly, go back in time, and start his revenge. But the world Keyaru traveled to is a different world where all the heroes were good people. On top of that, Keyaru lost his memories from the other world and his desire to take revenge, with a new life in front of him he decided to open a coffee shop with his childhood friend, Anna, without being recruited as a hero because the humans reconciled with the demons. In a new world in peace, many guest go to the coffee shop to eat Keyaru's delicious food.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 回復術士のおもてなし

128241.description: In the world of the Goddess Wellos, after sex, women are blessed with strength and good looks and men with good luck. The women who gain this godly strength and good looks become Paladins and participate in battle, and the men support the Paladins as Chevaliers. In Lente village, Kite, the son of a blacksmith, is a boy with a very strong libido. Former Paladin Lilia identifies him as a Chevalier candidate and encourages him to join the Royal Academy in the capital to become a Royal Chevalier.

title.native: セイクリッド・シュヴァリエ

128242.description: The lady of the Walters house, Cecilia Walters, loses her engagement ring, the cornerstone of her profitable relationship with Hans G. Manz. Maid Mia Bridget is blackmailed by Cecilia into helping her find the ring and enact her "second secret plan," all whilst keeping it under wraps to prevent a fuss, before Viscount Manz visits the next week.

128243.description:
Despite being born as a Fore Elf—one of the "beautiful creatures that inhabit the forest"—young Mell Risurisu suffers from poverty, a total lack of skills, and no magic powers whatsoever at her disposal. Determined to save her beloved little sisters from a life of hardship, Mell decides to join Enoch—the royal order of knights. Upon being assigned as a field medic to the Second Expeditionary Squadron, which boasts only four members to its name, she's shocked to discover...

Bread as hard as stone and rubbery jerky made of mystery meat?!

This simply won't do! Medic Risurisu's knowledge as a child of the forest is her greatest weapon in the battle for delicious food on the go!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: Rice for Enoch’s Second Expeditionary Unit

title.english: Expedition Cooking with the Enoch Royal Knights
title.native: エノク第二部隊の遠征ごはん
title.romaji: Enoku Dai Ni Butai no Ensei Gohan

128244.description:
“Don’t worry, father. I’m going to this evening party to find true love. I’m already 19…it wouldn’t be surprising for me to meet my fated person any time now..”

“Julia…It takes three days by carriage to reach the royal castle. Try to stay quiet as much as possible and not make any trouble.”

Stay quiet, you say?!! What exactly have I done wrong?

First groom candidate tried to marry me to obtain the rank, despite having multiple lovers. I only exposed his relationships at the public place. Well, I did gather the lovers he deceived as the proof, but the fact that they beat the sh*t out of him has nothing to do with me.

Next man, who possessed the rank of the Knight, with my help realised that he was romantically interested in other men and left happily while holding hands with his male lover. I only deserve to be praised for making him realise his true love.

The last groom candidate who was a civilian officer, even tried to kill me after his illegal deal with black market merchant was revealed. I managed to escape by a hair’s breadth, but if anything, I think that’s more of a feat, because if things went on, flour’s price would shoot up and many people would starve to death during the winter.

Well, all of this…means that neither of those men were my fated person.
synonyms: Women-Hating Duke Feels Lust Only For One Aristocrat Lady

title.native: 女嫌い公爵はただ一人の令嬢にのみ欲情する
title.romaji: Onnagirai Koushaku wa Tada Hitori no Reijou ni nomi Yokujou Suru

128245.description:
It’s a sweet fragile cage–

Shirley lost her parents in an accident. Her only remaining family is Ralph, her twin brother. Shirley is determined to protect her brother in her parent’s absence but is shocked when she hears rumors of him having a lover. Although it’s forbidden, her feelings for him swell and become indecent. Is this a dream?

128246.description:
Queen Lucienne has chosen Eric, the graceful and burly knight, to be her groom. She is finally able to share a kiss with the one she has always loved just like in her dreams. “You are mine, my adorable queen.”

A hot wedge pierces her lower abdomen, and intense pleasure crawls through her entire body.

“I will never leave you.”

In his tight embrace, she was happy…

Every day after that, as if he had let go of all restraints, she is devoured by absolute possessiveness.

This is the worryingly lewd newlywed life of a knight and a queen!

転生領主の優良開拓～前世の記憶を生かしてホワイトに努めたら、有能な人材が集まりすぎました～

Hoping to save herself from a gruesome death, Yeoju must figure out who to trust, harness Haewon’s inner chi, and learn martial arts as she fights to save the Sichuan Tang Clan. Can she change the outcome of the novel and prove she’s the worthy hero?

A main vocalist with the temper of a lion x a cheerful and straightforward bassist. Who knew that the band couple I fangirl about is actually real! In order to understand and save the band that is on the verge of getting disbanded, he found a child prodigy star, who had to secretly leave the entertainment industry because of a car accident. But, this gangster-like youth, who became a "backside singer" at a bar, how should I tame him? Should I chase after my dream or choose my husband? I want them both!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: How to Tame a Wild Lion

128279.description:
There is a huge tree called Spring Snow, which brings water to people. At the night of the festival to express gratitude to the tree, Kazuki sneaks into a forest to look for a fairy. He meets a girl, Caroline, there. She is actually a holy dancer performed in front of the tree at the festival. Inspired by her dance, Kazuki decides to enroll into a prestigious school. Though people around him say, "It's impossible," he passes the exam. His new school life now starts....

(Source: ErogeShop)

Succumbing to long-simmering jealousy over her younger sister, noblewoman Violette snaps and does something terrible. As she languishes in prison, something unexpected happens: time is rewound, sending her back to the day she first met her sister! Armed with the memories of her disastrous first go-round, Violette is determined to take the script in a different direction this time.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

128286.description: Mission T is a secret operation to save the world from destruction. Trained as a ninja from a young age, Botan Negoro, raised to become the ultimate spy, teams up with another excellent spy, Kuruma. Their aim is to recover the legacy of the genius inventor Nikola Tesla, the "Shards of Tesla." Can the two outwit the agents of other countries who are also pursuing these fragments? A super-original spy thriller begins.

128287.description:
This may seem just like baseball, but when you can switch out the bats for weapons and the balls for bullets, is it even still just a "game"? When idol Yuki Tengoku accidentally throws an unbelievable pitch, she gets invited to play for the lowest-ranked Death Ball, team Dangerous. But when she's dropped right into a game where nothing is off-limits, everyone has superpowers and special moves, and any wrong move could lose her uniform – is her uncontrollable hard fastball "Titanic" enough to keep her afloat?

(Source: Manga Planet)

128289.description:
Wilbur and Orville Wright started out repairing bicycles in a small Midwestern American city and went on to complete the first piloted, self-propelled flight in history. Since that fateful day in 1903, aviation and aerospace technology has developed by leaps and bounds. Now, in the twenty-first century, we are close to the day when people will travel freely between the earth and outer space. But we should never forget that the invention of the airplane began with two brothers tinkering in their bicycle shop. The Wright brothers achieved their vision of human flight through hard work, patience, and an unwavering belief in themselves and their dreams.

(Source: Shogakukan)

title.english: The Wright Brothers: Challengers of the Air

128290.description:
I only called to complain about the issue with my product… Yeong-Ha fell in love with the voice of the customer service operator. What if the man with that same voice appears in front of Yeong-Ha?! Yeong-Ha had just found the voice of his dreams. Eun-Seong, a man with a perfect and dreamy voice, who'd rather devote himself to work than be in a relationship. Seon-Nam, owner of the adult shop, "Adult Angel." Seon-Su, Yeong-Ha's first crush and judo athlete! A romantic love square between the three men and Yeong-Ha!

(Source: Wutopia Comics, edited)

128291.description:
A collection of three sections from each volume of the One Piece Magazine. These are stories from normal people's perspectives on the Straw Hat Pirates.

This includes a story of a Marine watching Luffy trying to protect Ace during Marineford and how it reflects their relationship with their younger brother, who is also a Marine on Marineford. Another story is of Zoro getting into an argument over who’s the best swordsman after Dressrosa. And another features a kid pirating Soul King’s concert on Sabaody Archipelago.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

128292.description:
The world's greatest exposition of the pirates, by the pirates, for the pirates—the Pirates Festival. Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat Crew receive an invitation from its host Buena Festa who is known as the Master of Festivities. They arrive to find a venue packed with glamorous pavilions and many pirates including the ones from the Worst Generation. The place is electric.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

128293.description:
A collection of short stories that were out-of-print and hard to find, re-edited and collected in a new edition. In the title story, two neighbors who were total strangers slowly became an important part of each other's lives. Other touching and emotional stories are also included.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

128294.description:
Masataka, an audio technician, has known Kei since his amateur rock days and used to treat him to ramen. But, now that Kei has become a top-selling artist, their positions are reversed. One day, Masataka is assigned to help with Kei's upcoming performance, and after the show he's invited to the after-party. Little did he realize it was an orgy!

(Source: Renta!)

128296.description:
Since childhood, Jiwon has been captivated by stories of vampires. He promised himself that if he ever encountered a real one, he would go out of his way to befriend them. Finally, during Jiwon's college years, the opportunity strikes when he witnesses a handsome vampire indulging in a feeding session. Filled with indescribable excitement, Jiwon attempts to approach and even offer his own blood to the vampire. However, to his dismay, the mysterious bloodsucker vanishes in an instant. Disappointed and brimming with unanswered questions, Jiwon attends class the next day only to discover that the man from the previous night is none other than Yoon Seong-hyun, a sunbae in the same class. Will this unexpected revelation set the stage for Jiwon's ultimate dream of forging an extraordinary friendship or, perhaps…something more?

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters and 5 Christmas special chapters.

128298.description:
“What do you think is the difference between a wartime hero and a murderer?”
Michirou, a college student aiming to become a mountain rescuer, is asked this question by his younger brother. Makoto, who is in jail for the attempted murder of his friend. While Michirou replies that it’s about the cause, Makoto thinks it’s just about the difference in times. When his younger brother is sentenced to prison, Michirou is at his wits’ end…
Suddenly, a red rain begins to fall, the detention center gets shrouded in mist…. and the surroundings turn into the Warring States Period.

128299.description:
Mina is a girl who has a strong hope of finding her destined person. With that goal in mind, she tries her best with different types of guys wishful of finding the right person. Even when her childhood friend, a yankee named Yuito, is already by her side. Will she ever find her destined person? A romantic comedy, coming-of-age tale of love and friendship.

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

128302.description:
I'm a character in an otome game?!

I'm Vincent, the butler of the Count's daughter. One day, I suddenly remembered that this world is one of an otome game that I played in my previous life. Furthermore, I remembered that the lady I adore will die a violent death as the villainess! Huh? Don't mess with me! I'll destroy my lady's destruction flag!! As her loving butler (and a capture target), I'll do everything I can to help my lady avoid her bad end.

This is an intense isekai reincarnation comedy!

128310.description: Centuries ago, wolves were cursed with an endless hunger and the only way to break it is to devour the heart of a Red Cloak - a descendant of the witch who cursed them. One wolf finally believes he may be able to break the curse of his species, but this Red Cloak is different than what the legends led them all to believe...

128311.description: Newly made by the Creator, Cleco struggles to find her niche in building the world around her.

128312.description:
The nightmares come again. They remind Seung-gyu that just 3 years ago, he was a helpless gigolo selling his body and soul for money… Money he wouldn't have spent on a bad investment if it weren't for his then roommate, Min. But that's all in the past. Now, Seung-gyu is in a position of power when it comes to money and sex. He's a successful account executive, and has an endless list of girls who're willing to come over for a good time. But when Min returns into his life as a new recruit at his company, Seung-gyu realizes the past can't be forgotten or forgiven. It's time for revenge.

(Source: Lezhin)

128313.description:
A sweet tale of companionship and found family set in Joseon dynasty Korea between a lonely young scholar with a kind but weak heart, a stray black kitten with a strange secret, and a loyal but jealous servant boy.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

128314.description:
This authorized biography spans Charles Schulz's life, from his youth growing up in Minnesota, through a burgeoning love of drawing and his time in the army, to becoming one of the most recognized and beloved cartoonists in the world. Told in a clear and welcoming style perfect for readers young and old, this gripping manga story touches on many real-world historical events that impacted Schulz's life, and the ways Peanuts impacted those events!

(Source: Udon Entertainment)

Note: Volume 19 in the series.

128315.description: During World War I, Ernst Udet and Georges Guynemer are in the midst of single combat when they suddenly find themselves enveloped in mysterious light before being whisked away to modern-day Utsunomiya?! A gag manga featuring pilots who each have their own colorful personality. From the “Red Baron” to Mick Mannock, they all join together to live under one roof!

128316.description:
Kouta Higashiyama’s father is the enormously wealthy founder of a corporate behemoth—but his mother was the man’s twenty-third mistress! He thought the issue of succession and inheritance had nothing to do with him. And it didn’t—until he was suddenly kidnapped as a candidate to be the next chairman, and dropped in front of five beautiful girls, all of whom are in contention to become his lover… But is his whole life really all about choosing whatever and whoever he wants? Or will Kouta himself be the one to be chosen…?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: ストラテジックラバーズ

128317.description:
This is the story of a young basketball player willing to do whatever it takes to get back on track. Demian Kawai has devoted himself to basketball with the goal of becoming the top scorer in the National Basketball Organization. For now, competition at the high school level is tough, especially if you can't measure up to the other players.

Despite his promising future, Demian is struck by a case of the yips, causing his arms to stiffen up and risking his chances to reach the big leagues! Now Demian will have to dig deep to power ahead in his climb to greatness.

(Source: Noir Caesar)

128319.description:
Serafina de Lavillant, the strongest female knight in the West, was sent to subjugate the barbaric tribes of the East. But when her mission fails spectacularly, she’s captured alive and imprisoned. Humiliated and dreading what horrific torture she’ll endure, she asks to be put to death. To her surprise, rather than tearing her limb from limb, the tribe leader asks for her hand…in marriage! Will Serafina face a cruel and abusive arranged marriage? Or will she discover that these tribes aren’t as barbaric as she was led to believe?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Thus, a story of love and hate will unfold in this old mansion. This is a fairy tale of vengeance and romance.

128338.description:
Sometimes, but quite rarely, there exists cases of people who possess memories of their past life. For example, you may recognize a city you have never been to before, know how to operate an airplane you have never seen before or even know a nickname that only the family of a dead person would know. And that is something that usually happens in the same world, but sometimes as if it was on a god’s whim, a soul with a memory of another world can cross the boundaries between the worlds.

And right now, a child with such a rare soul was born in a country in the middle of the continent. His name is Raymond and this is his story.
synonyms: I Was Born as the Seventh Prince, What Should I Do?

128343.description:
In rare cases, there are children that have reincarnated while holding the memories of their previous lives. Dependent on the god's caprice, they will be reincarnated into another world. One such case is the seventh prince of a certain kingdom.

The eldest son is the crown prince, the second, the third a diplomat, the fourth is bewed to the princess of another country, and the fifth and sixth are geniuses in music and art. Wait? Then what's left for me?
synonyms: I Was Born as the Seventh Prince, What Should I Do?

title.native: 第七王子に生まれたけど、何すりゃいいの？
title.romaji: Dai Nana Ouji ni Umareta Kedo, Nani Surya Ii no?

128346.description:
Kaoru Mitsuya has all but given up on living a meaningful life. Ensnared at a young age by the temptations of organized crime, he has neither a penny to his name nor anything he holds truly dear. It is at this lowest point that he encounters Yuichiro Shirouzu—a delicately beautiful florist with a secret or two hidden beneath his kind demeanor. When Yuichiro offers Kaoru a job at his nighttime flower shop, it marks a turning point for Kaoru, both in how he lives his life, and whom he wishes to spend it with…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The Dark Knight Jade is tasked with guarding Princess Vignetta, whose mother was the slain Demon Lord, as this was her last wish before perishing at the hands of the Hero. The Princess is but a sweet small child brimming with virtues, so Jade wonders:

When it comes to the time, will the Princess side with evil like her mother did and fight the Hero? A girl this sweet, no less?

128350.description:
Ceel was a boy who made and sold potions used to treat light wounds and colds. However, unbeknownst to him, they were actually no mere potions, but the legendary elixir that can cure all wounds and illness. One day, he came across a noble girl who had trouble walking as she was so out of breath. Apparently, she had an illness which herbalists, doctors and even magicians couldn’t cure, but she recovered fully from Ceel’s potion. His potions became popular overnight, with adventurers and nobles fighting to get ahold of it. A new chapter of the kind-hearted boy’s life begins with his accidental elixir creation—.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ポーション売りの少年 ～彼のポーションは実はなんでも治す伝説のエリクサーでした～
title.romaji: Potion Uri no Shounen: Kare no Potion wa Jitsu wa Nandemo Naosu Densetsu no Elixir deshita

title.romaji: Oudou Gakuen Renai: Fall in Love

title.romaji: Hotel Shangri-La: Kako to Mirai wo Tsunagu Basho

title.native: 看護しちゃうぞ―見習いナースは同級生

こいまほ　いもうとは魔法少女

title.romaji: Kyousei Hatsujou! Imouto no Kaihatsu Shita Himitsu Dougu de Osananajimi, Sensei, Idol wo......

128359.description:
In 17th century Europe, in the depths of a forest, lived a vampire boy named Isaac. He would devour all who entered his forest. Yet, he saved a girl named Livana solely because her flame-like hair resembled his mother's. In the process of this, memories of his mother are stirred up.

Meanwhile, Livana's family is continuously embroiled in a series of unfortunate events, and Livana herself is rejected by everyone due to her hair color. But Ethan has always adored her, and her brother seems to have unusual feelings for her. How will these people's feelings intertwine...?

128360.description:
Welcome to Ibana, a beautiful country also known as the red country. Here, lives the red fox, a wily beast who takes on the form of a human and feasts on the livers of humans. For hundreds of years, the fox kills without hesitation until, thanks to one human woman, it comes to know what that human emotion called “love”, truly is. Out of the land of fire, erupts the cruel yet tragic love story of one evil spirit who yearns to possess the heart of one human woman.

(Source: Netcomics)

128361.description:
Yuki Miyama is an up-and-coming young star. He has always adored Masataka Kitamura, a modern-day Valentino, and is excited to have the chance to work with the older actor, who ends the session by snorting at his performance. To make matters worse, Yuki gets totally smashed after Masataka toys with him over drinks. The next thing he knows, he's lying in bed... with Masataka! A love story about a naive model who is swayed every which way by a hot, mysterious actor!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: I Might Be Your Fan, but I'll Never Fall for You!
title.native: 推しには絶対ほだされない
ドラゴンズサマー 〜クロとわたしの夏休み〜
title.romaji: Dragon's Summer: Kuro to Watashi no Natsuyasumi

128363.description:
1. Satou Gashi no Ie (さとう菓子の家)
Elsie's childhood friend Richard suddenly appears at her school, holding a baby he claims to be his daughter! At only 17 years old he claims himself to be a widower and commits himself to raising this child. But what really happened while he and Elsie were apart? Who exactly is the child's mother? And how could he betray his promise to marry Elsie?

2. Akikaze no Nobo (秋風のノボ)
Aoi's first love, Nobo, disappeared at sea 7 years ago, but she still has hope that he's out there alive and well. Nobo's younger brother Yuu is Aoi's age and has never left her side. Will she ever let go of Nobo and accept Yuu's love?

3. Amefuri Banchou (雨ふり番長)
Mamoru is the school bancho and beloved by all for his handsome face and insistence on doing things the right way. But the appearance of Midori, an unguarded free spirit, turns brings back memories of his late younger sister.

4. Michel Ojisan no Hatsukoi (ミシェルおじさんの初恋)
Simon is one of 13 children. To escape the crowded household Simon moves in with uncle Michel on the French countryside.

5. Akimatsuri no Hi ni (秋まつりの日に) Susumu doesn't approve of his older sister Chiyoko's fiancé, Bon.
synonyms: ミシェルおじさんの初恋

128364.description:
A story about the slightly dangerous(!?) investment activities of three soft and fluffy JDs!

Every time the chart moves by 1mm in the wrong direction, I can feel the tears overflowing! A heart-stopping college-girl FX-trading comic for all those who want to have fun and make money!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Based on the doujin web manga of the same name published on Neetsha.

128365.description:
There was once a legendary lady who worked as a P.A. until she rose to become a well-known actress who was nominated for an Academy Award… Then, time passed, and we are in Yokohama today. Masaomi Hamura, son of Shio Kobayakawa, meets a mysterious girl without any family history, who calls herself Fuyuu. Will it be a fateful encounter?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: プライベート・アクターズ

128366.description:
Scorned by her lover and thrown into power after the mysterious assassination of her father, Latil must marry to secure her sovereignty of Tarium. Instead of choosing one man to become her Royal Consort, she chooses five young men from all walks of life to join her Harem. Will Latil ever solve her father’s murder, and can she keep the peace in her Harem?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: รังรักจักรพรรดินี

128373.description:
The daughter of a glass artisan family, Fukami Touko, spends relaxed days at a cafe called "Kazemichi" at a friend's house. On the summer vacation of her third year in high school. In front of them appeared a transfer student boy: Okikura Kakeru. He told Touko that he can hear the voices of the future. If someone knew in advance what their future would look like, what would they wish for? While feeling never-before-felt tremors in herself, Touko realises that she has started getting a feeling in her heart which she can't leave alone...

(Source: Official website)

title.native: 小説版 グラスリップ
じゃりン子チエ番外篇 どらン猫小鉄奮戦記
title.romaji: Jarinko Chie Bangai-hen: Doranko Kotetsu Funsenki

128375.description:
Bacteria are in all our bodies...good bacteria, bad bacteria, and everything in between! But this time, the bacteria are on a mission...to help their teenage host confess to her crush! Will they be able to protect her health?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

128377.description:
Shinzui, a country where perfumers are highly respected. Riri lives downtown, but her skills as a perfumer have earned her a place in the inner palace (harem) of the Crown Prince Kousho. However, her goal isn’t to become his favourite consort. Riri wishes to create the legendary treasured incense that her late father failed to produce, and clear his name. Kousho learned of her ulterior motive as soon as she entered the inner palace, and told her something unexpected!?

In a country where women aren’t allowed to become perfumers, a girl carves out her own destiny and finds love through the power of incenses.

128378.description: The otome game world’s villainess Millene’s past life was a Japanese high school girl. When she was young, she was a naughty kid, and now when she met the sparkling 17-year-old Prince Rendor, her memories returned, but the 15-year-old animal lover Millene once again had her heart stolen by him, while seemingly sticky and full of misundertandings, she’s trying her best to have a happy marriage, that kind of exciting and fairly sweet story.
synonyms: Is the Villain Not Allowed to Fall in Love?

title.native: 悪役は恋しちゃダメですか？
title.romaji: Akuyaku wa Koishicha Dame desu ka?

128379.description:
Twenty-nine year old Kuzuhara Kano loves her ordinary daily life above all else. While her friends are getting married and having children one after another, she is not in a rush nor does she have any aspirations, living a carefree single life. But one day, her life changes. By a twist of fate, she is suddenly proposed to by a handsome monk. No matter how handsome he is, it is impossible to marry a person you’ve just met!! Although Kano is surprised and instantly refused him, he still smiled charmingly and didn’t seem to give up. On the contrary, a sweet coercive approach has begun—
Too much doting, doesn’t he know the limits?! The sex appeal-dripping monk’s and a carefree girl’s sexual attraction at full throttle! A cute love story!

title.native: 僧侶さまの恋わずらい

128380.description:
I am inside the body of my friend. Now everything you own is mine, including your girlfriend!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

128381.description:
A man finally gets his first job only to find out he was hired for a more discrete and rewarding job.

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: 秘密のお仕事♥️～あなたに務まりますか？～

128382.description:
"Show me your place."

I thought it was okay because he's a police officer... but will I be violated if he stays here?

The ordinary office lady, Hiyori, lives in a peaceful city. She was caught in an accident by chance and fractured her arm. She decided to live with Kumano, a policeman who happened to be there. Hiyori was relieved because he was a police officer, however...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: その警察官、ときどき野獣！～鍛えたカラダに守られ＆襲われる絶倫生活～
Sono Keisatsukan, Tokidoki Yajuu!: Kitaeta Karada ni Mamorare & Osowareru Zetsurin Seikatsu

128384.description:
The manga is a remake of Shinji Wada's classic Showa-era manga Sukeban Deka in the Reiwa era.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

128386.description:
Based on Shinji Wada's Sukeban Deka manga, the Toki wo Kakeru Sukeban Deka manga's story centers on a high school girl named Tomoe, who is talented in karate, but lacks self-confidence and has a timid personality. She gets involved in a riot one day, and a mysterious man tells her to become a Sukeban detective. Tomoe travels across time and space, and meets another Sukeban detective, Saki Asamiya.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Sukeban Deka Who Leapt Through Time

title.native: 時をかけるスケバン刑事

128387.description:
A former young man from Japan is reincarnated as Golan, an ogre in the Demon World.

Currently, war is erupting all over the Demon World, and it is much like the feudal era. Furthermore, the residents of the Demon World are all of the happy-go-lucky sort. These people will take two steps forward if you take half a step back. Modesty is not a virtue in here. Regardless of what you think, you have to be strong in order to protect your own rights. That’s the Demon World.

Before he died, his mother told him, "you should protect your friends, even if it means risking your own life." And while he tries to follow his family’s mantra, problems face him at every corner. "I’ll protect all of my family!" Golan decides, but every day is the dark ages in the Demon World.

title.native: 魔界本紀 下剋上のゴーラン

128391.description:
The world he woke up in is long dead, dusted in ashen powder, and yet Keisuke still sees splashes of color as he travels through it. For the longest time, he’s wandered alone across the deserted landscape, clinging to the hope that something—or someone—might be out there in the emptiness. When he finally stumbles across that someone, even more threads of color start to seep into the ashen world around them. This time, when Keisuke sets off down the road, someone sits beside him in the passenger seat. The first acquaintance he’s ever made here, his first companion in this barren world. They’re both traveling in search of something, and after searching alone for so long, maybe they’ll have better luck working together? Their only lead is a witch who can answer any question—for a price. What will the two ask her, and what will she be able to tell them? More importantly, what will it cost them, and will they be willing to pay the price?

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Sayonara Isekai, Matakite Ashita Tabisuru Efude to Bakkupakku 30
即將永別的異世界、仍將來臨的明天
旅する絵筆とバックパック30

title.native: さよなら異世界、またきて明日

128393.description:
Si-Won Cha is obsessed with his popularity. Having transformed everything from his weight to his demeanor to remake himself into the perfect popular guy, he loves being the center of attention. What happens when he is challenged by over-eager and equally narcissistic rival Da-Un Hyeong? And why does Da-Un somehow think Si-Won has a crush on him?!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: There's Something Wrong With My Popularity
我的人气肯定出现了问题
Wo De Renqi Kending Chuxian le Wenti

title.native: いつもそばに しかるねこ

128401.description:
The official 4-Koma comic series based off of the Dragalia Lost mobile game.

Note: Includes 42 extra chapters.
synonyms: ドラガリアロスト　ゆるがりあ
ドラガリのはじめかた！
失落龍絆 第一次玩就上手！
失落的龙约 上手方法！
Shiluo Longban Diyici Wan Jiu Shangshou!
ナームのわくわく冒険記！
那姆的驚險刺激冒險記！

128402.description:
Hae-Seo seems to have it all: good looks, a caring personality, and a promising career as a speech coach. And, oh yeah, the ability to control people’s minds and see into the future! The only problem is, whenever he uses his powers, he develops a certain *ahem* rock-hard condition. So when stunningly handsome Do-Hyuk offers to lend a hand, Hae-Seo must learn to lower his defenses and open his heart—that is, until he discovers that Do-Hyuk has been keeping secrets of his own...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ลวงรัก กับดักฝัน

128403.description:
Yoon Haneul has always been a pushover, someone who would never say no. Then one day, she opens her eyes and realizes that she has become Aila Mertensia, the antagonist of a novel she had written ten years ago. Haneul is content to live the life of a rich couch potato and binge-read novels. But to her dismay, she soon finds herself stuck in a time loop where her day repeats endlessly, and the only way to escape the loop is to act like Aila Mertensia! Haneul doesn’t know the first thing about acting like a villainess. Luckily for her, a mysterious warlock by the name of Killian offers to help her become a true villainess. Her only option is to make a deal with him, but can Haneul really trust this devilishly handsome man?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: นางร้ายเมกเกอร์

128404.description:
"Je te veux. I want you."

Cheongsun and Gonghyeon meet as college students, but their differences in station and experience lead to a painful falling out. Ten years later, the two meet again in the world of hotel management and get to reminiscing about their short spring love all those years before...

128405.description:
"I want to make you cry." "I want to make you feel this even more..." Ryunosuke meets Sachi, a boy famous throughout the campus for his cuteness. He looks like the prettiest girl when he dresses up in women's clothing, but in reality he's tough, scrappy, and downright righteous. Ryunosuke is enticed by the contrast between these two sides of Sachi, and bumps into him after Sachi gets slipped a mickey at the school festival. The drug's really hitting Sachi hard, and Ryunosuke approaches him, telling him that he'll feel better right away if he does as Ryunosuke says. Seeing Sachi flushed and teary-eyed brings out the worst in Ryunosuke, who can't help saying things to toy with him, but then...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 世界で一番激しい愛の一方通行！
title.romaji: Sekai de Ichiban Hageshii Ai no Ippou Tsuukou!

128406.description:
Tenka Momose, a high school freshman that can sing and dance... she's pretty and smart to boot! She's good at everything but love. One day she meets Erian Satou, and was pulled in by her passionate dedication to becoming an idol. This is the story about two young girls chasing after their K-Pop idol dream!!

(Source: Comikey)

title.native: 引き籠り錬金術師は引き籠れない お家でのんびりしたい奮闘記
title.romaji: Hikikomori Renkinjutsushi wa Hikikomorenai: Oie de Nonbiri Shitai Funtouki

title.romaji: Kurai Kurage wa Rinjin Demo Ii

128412.description: Fujio Sera is a murderer on the run. He meets Yoko Itami, a deli clerk who is a big fan of Fujio's personal radio show, "Fudio's Radio". Their twisted secret escapade begins...

128413.description:
High schooler Aoto Ichigaya's light novels of forbidden love aren't exactly flying off the shelves—but he's got bigger problems right now. His cute-but-psycho stepsister Shizuku has decided the way to his heart is through hypnosis...which doesn't actually work, but Aoto isn't about to let her know that. Aoto's childhood friend, Rinko, might be his only hope of rescue—if he even needs rescuing at all. When your stepsister wants to kiss you and kill you, there's just no way for a guy to win!

(Source: Mangamo)
synonyms: My stepsister who says Go die go die to me every day, tries to hypnotize me to fall for her while I was sleeping...!

title.english: My Stepsister Who Tells Me To Die Every Day Tries to Hypnotize Me So I Would Fall for Her...!
title.native: 毎日死ね死ね言ってくる義妹が、俺が寝ている隙に催眠術で惚れさせようとしてくるんですけど……！
title.romaji: Mainichi Shine Shine Itte Kuru Gimai ga, Ore ga Neteiru Suki ni Saimin-jutsu de Hore Saseyou to Shite Kurundesu kedo…!

128414.description:
"Oh, you'll love me! And kiss me.."
My step-sister who is the same age as me treats me like garbage. This beauty, admired by everyone around her, shows her true ugly nature only in front of me. But upon learning that she loves me so much that she'd even use hypnosis to make me fall for her, what exactly am I supposed to do!? Shizuku asks for one embarrassing demand after the other while moving a 5-yen coin like a pendulum. As her brother, and as a man, which path should I take.....!?

The crazy hypnosis love-comedy, finally serialized!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)
synonyms: My stepsister who says Go die go die to me every day, tries to hypnotize me to fall for her while I was sleeping...!

title.native: 毎日死ね死ね言ってくる義妹が、俺が寝ている隙に催眠術で惚れさせようとしてくるんですけど……!
title.romaji: Mainichi Shine Shine Itte Kuru Gimai ga, Ore ga Neteiru Suki ni Saimin-jutsu de Hore Saseyou to Shite Kurundesu kedo…!

128415.description:
In a desert kingdom, childhood friends Loki, Tol, and Ingle care for each other as if they were family. However, Byaku, who's in love with Ingle, can't stand how close they are. In an effort to help him get with Ingle, Byaku's men ask Ingle to guard Byaku against a made-up stalker. However, Byaku and Ingle end up teaming up when someone from Ingle's dark past rears their ugly head again! This is the story of a wolf inexperienced in love and a snake hopelessly in love with him.

(Source: Renta!)

128416.description:
Natsuki's first love was his private tutor, Ryogo. Unfortunately, he ended up marrying Natsuki's sister, Yukiho. Years pass by, and all Natsuki had to console himself were dirty fantasies of Ryogo. That is, until Yukiko disappears, leaving Ryogo to take care of their twins. Ryogo asks Natsuki to help with raising them, and so beings their life together under the same roof!

Natsuki becomes overwhelmed by pent up desire and unreciprocated love. A long time of getting off clutching Ryogo's discarded clothes makes a sleepy kiss quickly turn into a heated hip-grinding affair.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Mommy Daddy -No Milk's Coming out of My Nipples!-
title.native: ママダディ♂～俺の乳首から母乳はでないっ！～
title.romaji: Mama Daddy♂: Ore no Chikubi kara Bonyuu wa Denai!

128421.description: Jun Kannazuki, a college student, takes a summer job at C Court, a struggling third-rate tennis magazine. Sent to cover the US Open on his own, he crosses paths with Ai Funatogawa, a rising Japanese player with a unique playing style. As he follows her journey, he gets pulled deeper into the intense world of professional tennis, making him question his own direction.

128422.description:
Lulu and Miku, a demonic couple who refused the task of "having sex with humans", tried to escape together.
Their instructor from the demon world gave the taboo "lewd demon couple" a task to redeem themselves. What is it?
A romantic comedy between a succubus and an incubus, by an up-and-coming artist!

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 恋する淫魔の禁欲生活

128423.description:
Shuuichirou has been able to sense unworldly spirits for most of his life, and it has made him sensitive in his interactions with other people. When his adoptive mother passes away, Shuuichirou decides it's time to set out on his own to find a new life. On the way, he is targeted by a malicious spirit and passes out. When he comes to, he finds himself in the home of a man named Ten. Ten is mysterious and taciturn, hiding behind a mask. But when the mask comes off, Shuuichirou is surprised to see the face of a man who has haunted his dreams for years. Who is Ten and what is their connection to each other?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 読者参加型アンソロジー シスター・コンプレックス
平穏を望む魔導師の平穏じゃない日常
title.romaji: Heion wo Nozomu Madoushi no Heion ja Nai Nichijou

128426.description: In a dramatic reversal of fate, the commoner Ludwik ascended the throne and became king. Once crowned, he was immediately told that the most important work of the king is “to welcome the princess from the highest lineage on the continent as your bride”! But then, the beautiful bride who appeared muttered, “gross…” upon seeing his face. Just like that, the new queen began to wage a cold war against Ludwik. A former god named Leoleshea has woken after sleeping for thousands of years, and her first demand is to meet “this era’s very best player!” She is introduced to Fay, an acclaimed rookie apostle. Together, they plan to challenge the gods and win the ultimate prize, but no one in human history has managed to clear ten games—because the gods can be capricious, outrageous, and sometimes downright incomprehensible! In the face of absurdity, what can the apostles do but enjoy the contest to its fullest?

School is hard, but love is even harder—especially when you’re as popular as Lee Do-Ha. Fortunately for him, his best friend Seo Jun has been by his side to ward off his worshippers since they were kids. Unfortunately for him, however, Jun has also been harboring a soul-crushing love for Do-Ha since the day they met. So when the two enter high school, Jun will do whatever it takes to keep Do-Ha safe from the swarms of admirers that hover around his every move. Under the pretense of keeping him safe from others’ affection, he takes the opportunity to realize his dream of a relationship with Do-Ha—even if it comes in the form of a contract with its own set of terms and conditions. As the two dive deeper into dating, will Jun and Do-Ha add up to be a 100% match? Or is Jun destined to live in love purgatory, always giving 99% of his heart to his one true love?

Unless they find a family that will love them, the stuffed animals in a certain shop keep growing until they're larger than life! Which is exactly what happened to the cute teddy bear Rio. He loves the boss and his friends who live in the store, though, so he hasn't been lonely. Then, one day, a new shopping mall calls up, looking to make Rio their mascot! Except... Rio would rather stay with his boss. In order to make this happen, he asks the owner (who happens to be a magician) to turn him into a human, but the magic doesn't last long! The two of them have to figure out how to make it last before the mall comes to pick him up if he's to stay that way...! This is a pure love story between a teddy bear-turned-boy who doesn't know what love is, and his hot-and-cold boss!

(Source: Futekiya)

A chance encounter brings Zhan Luo into her life and their surprising connections (including being engaged to her horrible sister!) keep pulling them back together. She wants nothing to do with this bad boy and yet the usually cold and standoffish Zhan can’t help but be drawn to her. He’ll basically do anything, yes, ANYTHING, to stay in her life! Cho-ah does his best to nurse the stranger back to health, despite the misgivings that his fellow students have about him. The man’s name is Mujin, and it soon becomes clear that the only person he trusts is Cho-ah. How will this handsome stranger change Cho-ah’s life?

But everything changes when the mysterious Do-Won inducts Hyeon into his secret other life. Infatuated with Do-Won and driven by his self-destructive instincts, Hyeon is drawn into a world of twisted desire and pleasure.

title.english: Falling in Love with You All Over Again

128589.description:
All Charlize Ronan ever wanted was to bring honor to her family. But instead, she is forced into becoming a “living sword” -- a mere tool for the emperors. It is from this hell that she prays for justice… and awakens in her former body. Now, determined to tear down this horrible empire, Charlize seeks out the young prince, Dylan Blade. She will put him on the throne, not as an honorable ruler, but as a tyrant. It is time for Charlize to tame the one who will bring forth her revenge.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Tamed a Tyrant and Ran Away
ฉันลวงทรราชให้ภักดีแล้วหนีจาก

128590.description: The composer, who lost his hand, decided to write the music for the young dancer of genius. A blossoming flower and an already faded flower. Music, which that was created in dreams, that was saturated with passion and poisoned by jealousy. Can she connect their hearts?
synonyms: Un Pas Seul sobre un clavier

128591.description:
"If you're not my rival, why do I feel this way?"

Blessed with both beauty and brains, it was only natural for Johann to be the top student at the Academy - that is until Elena Evoy appears. To make things worse, she seems completely unfazed by his charms, shattering his self-esteem. So why can't he stop thinking about her?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: My Observational Diary of Elena Evoy
Mon carnet d'observations sur Iléna Evoy
イレーナ・エボイ観察日誌
伊莲娜·埃沃的观察日志
บันทึกสังเกตการณ์ของอิเลน่า เอวอย

128592.description:
After waking up to find himself in another world, he comes face to face with the prince of the kingdom, Daniel, who looks exactly like him. In return for saving his life, the prince asks him to play his stand-in, basically to become his 'shadow.' He accepts and with a new name and identity, Rael serves the prince by taking on any given tasks. But what will he do when he's asked to spend a night with the emperor of the realm...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

128593.description:
Getting divorced is hard. But continuing to live with your ex-wife for her sick father is even harder. Still, it's a bit easier when you get to have her, and keep seeing the other beautiful women in your life.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

128594.description: In the midst of adolescent angst phase, Tsubaki Masato sees only danger in Maikawa Shirayuki, the beautiful new transfer student who is dazzling everyone with her overwhelming charm. But even though he is wary, Tsubaki can't help himself from falling for her. Meanwhile, a third person watches them from the darkness!
synonyms: 不能屈服於瞬間的愛情故事!

title.native: 瞬間ラブストーリーに屈しない!

128595.description:
I actually reincarnated into a different world and became the Demon King Overlord?! And my task is to destroy humanity! Wait, that ain't right. I'm a pacifist you know? I'm not like this at all? What? I killed a thousand human army with my energy blast?! That was an accident! It was the relic's fault! It's all a misunderstanding! Hahaha! Why can't we get along nicely? Huh? So what if I'm the devil? Doesn't mean I like doing bad things! Stop annoying me or I will blast you to kingdom come! Wait! Argh! Come on! I'm not that evil! I'm not the Overlord!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: I Am Not the Demon Lord

128596.description: Because of his gloomy appearance, Shinoyama Mei is treated like a loser by his classmates. In order to take revenge on the head of the bullies, Enoda, asks his occult-loving sister to make a poison(?). However, the poison turns out to be a love potion instead!!

128597.description: The year 1910. Iwamoto Kodou is a young boy who has successfully carried out many curious missions under the military's directive. His destinations lead to encounters with the strange, weaving tales of history that have yet to be told.
synonyms: บันทึกพิศวง ของ อิวาโมโตะ

128598.description:
A heartbroken guardian starts a symbiotic relationship with a guy to restore his faith in humanity.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

128599.description:
Su Yuan, a poor student, is accidentally admitted to Ogus Academy in order to release burden for the family. However, it is found that the college is set up to protect half-demons. The weak human begins must team with a half-demon pal (partner) for saving their lives. Su Yuan attracts many pal seekers due to his special smell and suffers various attacks at the same time. Until the day he saved a bloody fox, he found out...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

128600.description:
Audrey is a 30-year old employee at a small startup where she's been working for 5 years. How does she pull through the stressful, hard work? It's food--whenever the clock strikes lunchtime, she goes out to the streets to find new dishes. All from Kimbap Roll to Bibimbap, Audrey invites you to a journey of delicious cuisines in South Korea.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

128601.description:
Dimension Wave—a super popular VRMMO game where players can experience several years of fantasy in just twenty-four hours of real time.

Enticed by the entry ticket his sisters won, a young man takes part in the project's Second Wave. However, as soon as he enters the world of the game, he finds that his sisters have played a trick: he's been transformed into a girl with the cringy name Kizuna†Exceed.

But instead of letting it get to him, he decides to chill and take this new life as it comes. Without sparing a fraction of a second deciding, Kizuna immediately chooses to fish rather than fight on the front lines in this fantasy world. Alongside his sisters, Kanade and Tsumugi, a Japanese-style beauty named Shouko, Yamikage the fake ninja, and other quirky comrades, he works to enjoy his second life to the fullest.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: ディメンションウェーブ

128602.description:
The world has been plagued by monsters ever since the appearance of an inter-dimensional portal called the “Dark Abyss.” Special mages, known as portal protectors, must fight to keep the Dark Abyss under control. Among them, Baiyu is undoubtedly the strongest, and he full well knows it. But his arrogant personality gets the better of him when he jumps into battle one day unprepared for his hardest opponent yet, which then results in his untimely death. Things aren’t completely over though, as he is reincarnated two years later into the body of a teen boy. And with the special power of the gods bestowed to him in this life, will Baiyu finally be able to save the world from falling into darkness?

(Source: Tappytoon)

128603.description:
An irreparable painting and a young auxilium whisk an archeology major into the fantastical world of deities who protect culture. "If everything about you disappears, then let me be the last one to remember you."

(Source: WeComics)

128604.description: One boy that can transform himself cute as a magical girl when figting, long to be like the heroe of his city, with his beautiful mecha suit, but in reality inside that suit is a girl that want to be like the ideal magical girl of her city. A funny 4-koma comedy full of misfortune!

128605.description: The original one-shot chapter of Shokugeki no Soma. This chapter is unrelated to the canon story and is an alternate universe involving alternate versions of Souma Yukihira and Erina Nakiri.  It was later included as a bonus at the end of the serialized version's first volume.

title.native: 食戟のソーマ: 読み切り版

128606.description:
I was sued by the top actress Jia Shinji for malicious comments written by my girlfriend using my ID as playful and jealous. I'm preparing for the civil service exam, and a criminal record would be fatal! I must meet her no matter what!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

128607.description:
Betrayed and exiled from the sumo world, the late ozeki Karyu left behind a son, Koitaro Samejima, who carries his father's final words etched in his heart. As young Koitaro steps into the ring, the sumo world braces itself for an earth-shattering revolution! An authentic sumo manga that holds nothing back!

(Source: Emaqi)

title.native: 彼女のイマジナリーフレンド

128609.description:
Ordinary high schooler Yukikazu Totsuka suddenly finds his life turned upside down when he's transported to another universe — along with his whole class! While his classmates are hailed as heroes and appointed warriors in the new world, Yukikazu chooses to follow a different path: starting from the ground up as a humble military recruit. Can he climb the ranks, survive life as a soldier, and find out the truth behind this mysterious summoning?

(Source: Mangamo)
synonyms: I Was Invited to Join the Country as an Otherworldly Warrior, but I Refused and Decided to Start as a Soldier

title.english: I Was Invited to the Otherworldly Country as a Warrior, But Refused and Decided to Start as a Soldier
title.native: 異世界の戦士として国に招かれたけど、断って兵士から始める事にした
title.romaji: Isekai no Senshi Toshite Kuni ni Manekareta Kedo, Kotowatte Heishi Kara Hajimeru Koto ni Shita

128610.description: Metroid EX: Samus and Joey centers around Samus Aran, who lost her Power Suit upgrades to Greed, a creature of the same species as her nemesis Ridley. With the help of Joey Apronika and Diesel, Samus works to recover them in perilous adventures across the Extreme Galaxy.

128612.description:
Long neglected by her husband the Duke Antoure, Roxina decides to end their unhappy marriage. But knowing she will be forced into yet another loveless arrangement, Roxina makes a final deal with her husband to enjoy a brief period of sexual freedom in their impending divorce. While Antoure reluctantly agrees, he clearly seems to have plans of his own...
