Craft is an adventurer with the magician's crest. However, he has absolutely no talent as a magician! One day, after having been fired from yet another party due to his lack of latent, he had his crest changed at the recommendation of a crest inspector. His new crest turned out to be the legendary "Twilight Alchemist"! Craft, the weakest magi turned strongest alchemist, now sets out to slay monsters! ...Or not! Instead, he'll be settling the frontier! Unaware of his potential, the legendary alchemist's peaceful life starts here!

(Source: Manga UP!)

One year ago, I wandered into a different world. Instead of falling in love and making great memories, I found myself cooking, cleaning and doing laundary for student’s of Adergart knight academy.

Eventually I somehow traveled back to my former world, but— one year later, I returned once again! What? Moreover, it looks like 10 years have passed here? And it seems that birth rate for females decreased drastically, which led to start of multi-husband system?

Last year’s young boys who hasn’t been married yet, now were chasing after me.

Heartwarming love and inescapable reverse harem.

128619.description:
After a debilitating war against the human kingdom, Hell has lost its power and glory, and even running out of the money to pay its Demon soldiers and servants. Even the Demon King, Hel, relies on two of his most loyal servants for livelihood. To bring Hell back to its golden days, Hel decides to become independent and earn enough money on his own to save his kingdom from financial destruction. He decides to start his first job ever at a Knight's Private Club in the human world. Now, he has to work and survive in an unfamiliar place against its customers, many of whom used to be his enemy.

Raised by the legendary mercenary Ains Worker, the girl Sierra was sent to the royal school in the capital to learn how to live an ordinary life. Having spent her whole life on the battlefield, she has to rely on a notebook from Ains for tips on how to act like a normal person. But no matter how hard Sierra tries to act unobtrusively in school, her skills become obvious to all.

When she meets the girl Aruna, they become friends, and Aruna helps Sierra stay out of trouble. Their relationship deepens, not knowing Aruna is caught in a plot for the inheritance of the throne…

128628.description:
The moment he has contact with the person he loves, he "disappears". Masaki, a sommelier that works at a Bistro, lives together with his lover Kairi, a theatrical actor. Even though they both love each other deeply, there's an obstacle getting in the way of their relationship. And that's the fact that Kairi has multiple personalities...
Each time they are about to have sex, one of Kairi's personalities pops out, preventing them from having sexual relations. Masaki is against the wall since all he wishes is to take care of Kairi, but the desire of wanting to hold him is equally strong... But Kairi has a severe trauma when it comes to sex...?

Chiaki is a tax accountant who likes collecting glasses and playing with men. One day, he goes to a potential new client's restaurant and meets Suda, the manager. The two hit it off once they realize they are both into spectacles, and go out for drinks. Chiaki's bad habit of hitting on guys rears its ugly head, and Suda catches him in the act. Surprised to learn that Chiaki likes men, Suda forces him to suck on his member until it explodes all over Chiaki's face...! 128630.description:
At a gay bar, a serious-looking businessman who goes by the name of "Goto" approaches Akira, a high school senior. Clearly not used to this sort of scene, Goto nervously asks Akira to name his price. The look of anxiety in his eyes perks Akira's interest... A free-spirited high schooler meets a shy and pure businessman in this heart-pounding love story!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: This Guy Says He'll Pay Me
title.native: 後藤さんは俺を買いたい

128631.description:
"Is he rich or not?"

That's how Kureha (27) chooses her men.

While Taisuke (29) only chooses a woman based on her figure.

They're at the worst mixer ever, but these two trashy individuals, who are loyal to their desires alone, have a fateful encounter. In order to win the other over, they both pretend to be the selfless, reserved gentleman and lady as the distance between them closes, but...

The realistic yet silent game of offense and defense for these two will make you burst out laughing! Laugh along as these two have their inevitable love story!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Love Is Drenched in Desire Already

title.native: そもそも恋は欲だらけ

128632.description:
Working at a café seemed like the perfect job for Ziqi. It’s cute, pays the bills, and best of all… FREE FOOD! But there’s a problem: it’s a cat café and she’s terrified of cats! This isn’t your usual café though, here the cat’s help too... sometimes. Together with her kitty coworkers Boss the Persian, Luna the Siamese, Jury the tabby, Coco the munchkin, and Mimi the mixed stray, how can she pawssibly survive?! Welcome to Cafe Schrödinger!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: We Invite You to the Cat Café
カフェ・シュレディンガー

128633.description:
"I know where you like it now..." Seeing the woman who looks identical to his ex-wife, his feelings go berserk, making his body want her...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Each chapter is split into 3 ‘episodes’ in the English serialization.

title.romaji: Mototsuma no Musume wo, Osou.: Sono Omokage ni Yokujou Shite...

128634.description:
"Hey you, Livestock, I need a subject for my alien probe" are not words Haesung expected to ever hear. He spends his days spacing out, hopelessly fantasizing about being tied up by his office crush, Shiwon. But his secret BDSM fantasies come to life as a brutally sexy alien crash-lands on Earth and ropes in Haesung as his research subject (and roommate). Things heat up when Haesung submits to the experiment—in exchange for sexual favors that are out of this world!

(Source: Tapas)

128635.description:
Xu Wang belongs to the secret top combat force of the Z country-the Snow Wolf team, being the only one who maintains 100% win rate in the history of the Snow Wolf team, he was given the title of Snow Wolf, which was an exception. After retiring, Xu Wang was forced to be the fiance of the perfect female president Bai Feifei, who, however, looked down on him. Let's see how Xu Wang will rule the world and start an extraordinary life as a single soldier!

(Source: WebComics)

128636.description:
A thousand years ago, Deity Yuxu was killed by the Demon King in order to save the cat demon Yingwan, sending his soul into the cycle of reincarnation. A thousand years later, Yingwan finds Yuxu's reincarnation in the city and tries to pick up where they left off. However, Yingwan is already on the brink of death... Can the two of them survive all the odds and end up together again?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: High Immortal, Do You Lack a Cat?

128637.description: Three yakuza go through a life normal people cannot even imagine. The strife, the love and the complex relationships unwind as their lives continue on.

128639.description: A pair of conjoined siblings prepares for surgery, where they will finally be split into two separate people.

The usually quiet girl is moving her hips on her own... Asking me to go deeper... Letting me do whatever I want... This side of her only I know... I want to see more of it.

(Source: Coolmic)

Volume 1: Jimihen!!: Jimiko wo Kaechau Jun Isei Kouyuu (じみへんっ！！～地味子を変えちゃう純異性交遊～)
Volume 2: Jimihen!!: Jimiko ga Torokeru Dekiai Seikou (じみへんっ！！～地味子がトロける溺愛性交～)

128642.description:
Danger can come in many shapes and sizes, and the kind of danger Yeo Eui-joon has to deal with comes in the form of buff, brash, belligerent gangsters. He knew that working nights in a shifty neighborhood wouldn’t be the safest job on the planet, but reality sure does exceed expectations. However, Eui-joon’s days as the neighborhood punching bag look like they’re coming to a close when Gunwoo steps into this small store. Gunwoo, gruff as he is, genuinely seems to care about Eui-joon’s well-being, so it doesn't take long for Eui-joon to fall for this charismatic giant.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

128644.description:
Lee Hae-min who attends the elite school, Choegang High School! The reason why he, who is a model student, transferred to Choi Hwa High School, the complete opposite of Choegang High School, was to find a handsome man..?!

(Source: BomToon, translated)

128645.description: Lin Yuan helps his parents look after the flower shop every weekend. One day, a beautiful guest came to the flower shop, threatening to "seduce" Lin Yuan. Later, this guest launched a fierce offensive against him. On the night when Lin Yuan's feelings for this guest increased, he stumbled upon his unspeakable secret...

128647.description: Takas and Ainono, two teenaged exorcists, decide to go on a monster hunt in order to fund a trip overseas.

title.native: リリー・オン・ゼ・ブレード

title.native: 妖狐と考古のお姉さん

128649.description: Hiroshi is enrolled in a special elementary school with a challenging leadership program. Every two years, the classes are mixed up, and a fight to establish who is the leader of the class begins. Using his copy of Machiavelli's Prince as a reference, Hiroshi struggles against his clever and charismatic classmates to increase his number of followers and thus acquire the coveted position of class leader!

128651.description:
Siyeon, who returns home after studying abroad for college, finds out about the 'Understanding Wine' course that her younger sister has picked for her.
It's very popular because it's about tasting wine, but Siyeon is a lightweight that can't drink alcohol!
When she decides to correct the course and attended it, she is reunited with her high school friend Eunha... !?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

128652.description: A story about a girl named Runa Yureto, who has Phantom Vibration Syndrome, that basically makes her not stop vibing.
synonyms: The Same Old Kouhai Runa Yureto

title.native: あの子はいつも揺戸瑠菜
title.romaji: Ano ko wa itsumo Yureto runa

128653.description: After a wide-scale restructuring, Monjirou loses his job and starts wandering the streets. There, he ends up saving an old man who just happens to be the leader of Eastern Japan's greatest yakuza organization, the Zakuro Group. Suddenly, without warning, this leader decides that Monjirou is the perfect man to succeed him! How does Monjirou adapt to the world of the yakuza? Does he really have what it takes? Find out in this sex-and-violence-filled yakuza thriller!

128654.description: A story about a boy who looked, and the girl who caught him.

128656.description:
On the last day before a guy who can't sense any spirits at all moves out from his supposedly haunted house, Kinako-sama, the self-proclaimed strongest earth-bound spirit, will try her best to scare the living hell out of the guy before he leaves for good.

Note: Originally a web manga released on the author's Twitter and pixiv accounts since November 30, 2019, it was picked up for commercial print publication by Kadokawa on January 26, 2023.

128658.description:
Kodai Okuhira, is the director of a large corporation. Yukino Miyachi, his excellent and beautiful new secretary, is an assassin on a mission to kill Kodai. The night that she was going to carry out her mission, she makes the mistake that changes her destiny significantly. It is very difficult to fulfill her job as an assassin, when she's newly married to a husband with a great sexual appetite!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Kyou mo Korosezu ni Ai Shiau dake.

title.native: 今日も殺せずに愛し合うだけ。

Sally was just a normal girl who enjoyed skipping classes and eating late night snacks with her best friend... Until the time came for her to save the world!

(Source: Toomics)

128661.description:
The life of an ordinary beta is overtaken by an omega!
Who is he that only Mr. B doesn't know?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

128662.description:
From cooking, to cleaning, to everything in between, Ha-yeon is the perfect housekeeper! There’s just one issue… Woojin, who translates erotic novels for a living, keeps seeing his hottie of a housekeeper in his fantasies! Maybe it’s just Woojin’s lack of bedroom experience making him sexually frustrated but he’s gotta take care of this situation before things get out of hand. Woojin’s old friend, the mischievous Sol, sends him something to try to help him out, but when Ha-yeon catches Woojin in a most compromising position with the gift, will this shocking discovery be too big a load for the both of them to bear?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 24 extra chapters.

128663.description:
"Will this make you happy?" Nam-Woo wakes up one night to find bills sprawled all over his room - along with the hazy memory of a handsome stranger. Even in his wildest dreams, all Nam-Woo wants is to have enough money to survive each month. Si-Eon, on the other hand, has everything he could ever want except happiness. Intrigued by Nam-Woo's humble wishes, Si-Eon offers him the money he wants - the catch being, he has to date him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

128664.description:
"If it's Tsumugi's tits, you can suck on them as much as you like."

Tsumugi and Kosei have had a secret habit since they were little. That is... to let Mitsumugi's tits be sucked by Kosei. At first, I wanted to comfort him. At first it was just to comfort him. But as puberty hits, the relationship changes more and more...

128665.description:
After saying "I wanted to meet you for a very long time." Kunitama, a cat, jumped onto the chest of a university student, Makoto. However, the "destined person" that Kunitama have been searching for turns out to be Makoto's older brother, and to make things worse he's already married. She was expecting a bushy coat of fur because she heard that it was a race like that of a beast, but the husband who appeared in front of her was a tall handsome guy rather than a furry creature!

Officially: This is a story of where a small girl was discovered to be the King’s illegitimate child, was supplied with a robust army of soldiers called Dog People and governs over the country.

128673.description:
Tina is a girl with red eyes and white hair who comes from a family of hunters. She found an abandoned wolf cub in the forest and took it in. But it turns out that the cub is actually a werewolf boy named Adolf who wants join human society. How will Tina train the wild wolf in the ways of civilization?

Thousands of years in the future, a city known as “Eden 3” is inhabited solely by robots whose former masters vanished a long time ago. On a routine assignment, two farming robots accidentally awaken a human baby girl from stasis questioning all they were taught to believe -- that humans were nothing more than a forbidden ancient myth. 128676.description: Musashi Mizoguchi is a taxi driver living a lonely life after his family was murdered. One day he picked up two little girls who offered him a million dollars to take them to a warehouse. There he found a heavily armed young woman with a room full of bodies. Turns out she's an assassin with the ability to stop time, but only when she's sexually excited by stripping!! When she wakes up, she finds herself back to her young age with the only ambition to avenge herself on those who turn their back on her, especially her royal brother. A born failure is posessed by a dragon. He's bestowed with the will and power of this magical creature. With scales and claws, he can travel on water and breath fire. Lucifer is the strongest Demon Lord in history who ruled over the other clans with absolute power. During the entrance examinations, he easily achieved the top position in the three areas of swordsmanship, physical ability and magic, earning him the spotlight throughout the academy…… The school life of the world’s strongest demon lord now starts!

Sorimachi-kun is handsome, smart, well-liked, and has a bit of a rebel attitude. How could it be possible that this guy doesn’t have a girlfriend?

Mistia Erlaine is the daughter of a noble family who just started at high school. She’s surrounded by a group of adoring classmates and her charming fiancé. Everything seems perfect.

Except that this world is actually a dating sim called “Kyun Love”, and she’s destined to become the main character’s evil rival! Mistia is determined to do everything she can to avoid her fate but it’s not as easy as it sounds. Especially when all the boys keep falling in love with her!

PKST has been caught in jail after a heist, and Torazo is the only one that isn't in the prison. Will Peinto, Kuronoa and Sinigami be able to escape safely...

128702.description:
"A German girl would even go as far as doing that while taking a bath with me!?"

Shuu found himself hosting a visitor for a homestay, as a request from his parents who have been assigned to work in Germany. And so, a beautiful exchange student named "Mia" arrives at his house.

"Living under one roof with a German girl who's got an attractive face and figure..."
The unexpected meeting made his heart race, but what awaited the two of them them was a lifestyle of living together filled with difficulty in communication, including their cultural differences. Shuu is running around in circles unable to understand Mia's behavior, and that leaves him with no time to rest.

On one such day, the tired Shuu is taking a bath when she comes over and says "Have you washed your body? ...sit over here. I'll help you."
For some reason, appearing now before him was the figure of Mia standing right there, with her captivating body exposed. Shaken by this sudden turn of events, he is unable to turn down her offer and winds up getting her to help him wash his body, from his shoulder down to his back, from his back to his chest, from his chest, down to his waist...

Her behavior gradually starts escalating...

This is a flirty love manga about things like getting your body carefully washed in the bath by a beautiful German girl, and having lovey-dovey sex with her.

128706.description:
Enter the strange world of Imiri Sakabashira, whose denizens are zoomorphic creatures that emerge from one another as well as their equally bizarre environs. The Box Man follows its protagonists along a scooter trip through a complex landscape that oscillates between a dense city, a countryside simplified to near abstraction, and hybrids of the two; the theme of hybridity permeates throughout. One is unsurprised to encounter a creature that is half elderly man, half crab, or a flying frog in this world where our guide apparent is an anthropomorphic, mollusk-like cat. Sakabashira weaves this absurdist tale into a seamless tapestry constructed of elements as seemingly disparate as Japanese folklore, pop culture, and surrealism.Within these panels, it becomes difficult to distinguish between the animate and the inanimate, the real and the imagined—a tension that adds a layer of complexity to this near-wordless psychedelic travelogue.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Suddenly transmigrating into deep forest, only to run into a superstar actor?! Wait, isn't this the plot of the TV drama that I just watched?

Wang Xiaoyu, an ordinary girl who loves watching TV dramas, found herself crossing into the world of the TV show. Now she's accidentally messed up the plot progression and caught the attention of the protagonists…

There's lots of ways to get a girl. Gyeong-Su has never had a girlfriend, and his friends are out to help him find one... The lesson begins now!

Han-Soo is an aspiring civil servant, preparing for the civil service exam. One day, he runs into his first love, Ji-Yeon, who also is preparing for an exam. She is joining a notorious "study club" for hookups.

The first and titular story is about a man who is left wondering why his fiancée took her own life shortly before their wedding.

128729.description:
Xiang Yang, a rebellious and unruly teenager, doesn't care about rules and other people at all. Adults don't know what to do with him, and his classmates are afraid of him. However, he attracts Mingxu's attention. As the class monitor, Mingxu starts to have complex feelings about him. Mingxu cares about him, pity him, but is also mad at him. Maybe there's also affection. By showing his constant gentleness, and if necessary, toughness, Mingxu eventually moved Xiang Yang. What spark will the two tough guys create? Will they make it through the way that is full of laughter and tears and get their salvation in the end?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

128730.description:
Joachim Hjerpe is the one and only sniper of the Secret Intelligence Agency, an organization of individuals with very special abilities. The life of a sniper is extremely stressful, but quitting is not an option, as doing so could mean his own death. His only reprieve is meeting with his seductive and handsome lover, Juergen Eisler, who knows exactly how to fulfill Joachim’s needs. But when the dangers of his professional life threaten to invade his personal life, Joachim decides to part ways with Juergen before it’s too late. Juergen has no idea why Joachim suddenly wants to break up, and he’d sooner keep Joachim in shackles than let him walk out of his life. Will Juergen be able to persuade Joachim to tell him the truth?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Having a secret crush is just like drinking a bottle of hard liquor. You clearly know that it will make you light-headed, lose your cool, and suffer. Yet, just like a moth to the flames, you endure the pain knowingly. "You stop right after having a sip of it but, as for me… I'm drunk in love."

Claudia De Porto is a dear princess of Porto who was about to have the most perfect 19th birthday with her brother Juverin, who had prepared her birthday party to be everything she dreamed of, and Prince Kim, who was going to propose to her.However, right in the middle of Prince Kim's proposal, Porto Castle bursts into flames from Demon King's attack. One day, an accident occurs right in front of Ai's eyes. The girl who was supposedly run over quickly repairs her wounds and asks Ai to help her escape. This is an apocalyptic science fiction story about two girls.

128751.description:
A world where all monsters have been defeated and there's no work left for heroes. Gotou and Akihara have disbanded their hero duo and are thinking about their futures, but they're attacked by former heroes that once fought by their side...

(Source: Jump SQ, translated)

The Chois are a family whose people have sacrificed daughters in exchange for wealth and prosperity for generations. Having made a promise with an unknown man, the family has considered the birth of a girl a taboo for many years, in fear of losing their wealth… This is the Asian fantasy tale of the only girl born into the Choi family!

After witnessing a murder and being spared by the murderer as a child, Chris has been obsessed with playing detective, and researching crimes whenever he can. When Chris goes to college, he is assigned to the same room as Max. Chris finds Max fascinating because he is a lot similar to him. In order to fit in, Max decides to not push Chris away. This thrilling story showcases the bonds of brotherhood and unwavering dedication of these soldiers as they fight to protect the innocent and make it out alive.

Ma-Ru Kang was just an ordinary kid with ordinary interests, until one day his father forces him to watch a soccer game on TV, sparking an obsession with the sport. Filled with determination, he sets a new goal for himself -- to become an amazing soccer player! The only problem is, he has already been proclaimed the “King of the Losers” at his high school. Can Ma-Ru overcome the obstacles in his path and transform into a talented and successful soccer player?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

128784.description:
Yang Seojun, director of Taeyang Solar, finds himself caught in a life-threatening storm during a vacation hike in Sweden. As he takes shelter, he meets a pretty writer named Ji Eun who offers him the last of her food as they await rescue. But when he's back home, he just can't forget her, so he concocts a company-funded writing contest to find her. It won't be easy... even his assistant has her reasons to prevent their reunion. Will Seojun find Ji Eun again, or will she be lost to him forever?

(Source: Tapas)

Akira, who has nowhere to go, decides to live together in a true house while helping out. He was clear to hold the truth while whispering sweet words "Become a family" every night, but when he asked what he was doing after he went missing, he didn't answer for some reason ...?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Min Jeong-U has the ability to see misfortune and Seok-Hwan has the ability to come back to life. The two heroes made different choices... Who will be the final winner?

When an annoying guy at work mocks her lack of femininity, Shoko gets dead drunk and begs for help from Jun, a boy at the bar whose beauty could outshine any girl, until she's talked him into coaching her on how to power up her feminine side. But Jun gives her two conditions: she has to live with him, and he gets to touch her breasts... This beautiful younger man's super erotic touchy-feely coaching is steadily training my body!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

128791.description:
This is an examination that puts your life at stake. Answer a plethora of questions, pass the exam, and you may live. Two-faced examiner, Qin Jiu, meets the cold examinee, You Huo. In this inhumane system, both of them who have lost their memories go head to head against each other. Despite that, they have a strong mutual understanding. Alarms go off and the system collapses time and time again. During which, their memories gradually return. It turns out that even at the end of the world where there's only dust left, you're still the first person I met. What's so great about this system? We'll just destroy it. The world is brilliant and grand still, so welcome home.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Haruhiko is a 32 year old fat shut-in. One night he gets hit by a bus and finds himself summoned to a new world. 128798.description: Crest was born as the fifth son of a duke. However, as the fifth son, he was in no position to talk. His childhood friend and also his fiancée, Ellis, treated him just like a slave. And on Crest's coming-of-age ceremony, he received a skill called "Gacha." Yet, he wasn't able to learn how to use it and was banished away from his home. Banished into the forest full of monsters, Crest began to understand the power "Gacha." And then, Crest made up his mind. He will definitely survive and get back on his feet.

When Lizel mysteriously finds himself in a city that bears odd similarities to his own but clearly isn't, he quickly comes to terms with the unlikely truth: this is an entirely different world. Even so, laid-back Lizel isn't the type to panic. He immediately sets out to learn more about this strange place, and to help him do so, hires a seasoned adventurer named Gil as his tour guide and protector.

Until he's able to find a way home, Lizel figures this is a perfect opportunity to explore a new way of life adventuring as part of a guild. After all, he's sure he'll go home eventually... might as well enjoy the otherworldly vacation for now!

128801.description:
“I will become the world’s most wonderful maid!”

With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count’s family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Hinoharu Kota is newly married but his wife is never home. Bored, Kota imagines being on a relaxing ski trip to clear his mind. In his "dream" everything goes sideways. Still dreaming, Kota walks through a couple of doorways to shockingly find himself springing into action to save a female knight from a giant spider. Kota discovers he was "summoned" to this other world as something known as a summon beast, a helper that can be transported from his earth to other realms. As he completes these summoned missions as a summon beast, he can gain magical powers and abilities. As a man without any special skills on his own earth, this might be the best thing that has ever happened to him.

(Source: Mangamo)

128806.description:
The life of an assassin is many things: dangerous, lonely, short... and above all, ill-suited for love. Those were the rules Joaquin agreed to and accepted without question until the fateful day a young man named Davion saved his life. But the life of an assassin is no fairy tale. In an odd twist of fate, Joaquin ended up ripping away everything Davion held dear, and has since taken it upon himself to train the young man on how to get his revenge against everyone involved... including Joaquin himself.

(Source: Tapas)

128807.description:
In a kingdom inspired by historical China, five clans put forth their maidens as imperial consorts–but only one will be crowned empress. The frail and beautiful Kou Reirin, the so-called “butterfly” of the imperial court, is a shoo-in to marry the crown prince. But when “court rat” Shu Keigetsu lashes out at her during the glittering Lantern Festival, it’s Reirin who wakes up in the dungeons! Body-swapped by her assailant to steal her position at court, Reirin’s plight seems dire…to everyone else! Now that she’s got a robust new body, not even the looming threat of execution can stop her!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

When Minato died in an unfortunate accident, he was reincarnated in a different world where magic was woefully underdeveloped. Superfluous magic circles. Barely working attack magics.

"What's with these inefficient magic?"

By getting rid of the excesses in the magic circle, the destructive capabilities of the magic can be multiplied! Furthermore, he creates the flawless Extreme magic with his own hands. With his boundless wisdom, Minato enhances magic beyond wonder. In no time, his magical powers and techniques outclassed anyone else's. In a world where magic was lost to the people, Minato is praised as an omnipotent wise man who controls all of the elements.

The tale of a wise man commanding the lost magic with overwhelming power starts now!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

128821.description:
After his tragic death, Minato was reborn in a world where Offensive Magic has not been banned. He was thrilled to see that Offensive Magic for the first time, however he couldn't help but wonder why all the magic circles are so inefficient?! After witnessing how ineffective the magic in this new world is, he decides to use knowledge from his previous, far more advanced world to improve it. Come along on Minato's quest to improve the magic of his new home!

128822.description:
He spent 100-million yen on luxuries in two weeks, filmed 3,000 and had sex with 7,000 women, divorced twice, owed 5-billion yen in debt, has seven criminal convictions, and the U.S. Justice Department tried to put him in prison for 370 years. This man is real! Here is the life of legendary porn director Toru Muranishi... The bestseller that has also been dramatized on Netflix has finally been adapted into a manga!

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

128823.description:
Makoto, a librarian, and Seijiro, a veteran gardener.

In both cases, the two who have reached the "end" of something happened to meet each other, and while leaving regrets by yesterday, they hit it off. When I realized that I was actually led by fate —— !?

An adult love story that depicts "new days" starting from "year difference 40 years old"!

128826.description:
Lim Iro is a BL writer, and a pretty successful one at that! His last project was lavished with praise by everyone… Well, almost everyone. Under pressure from his unimpressed parents, Iro is forced into applying for a “real” job. But instead of a cover letter, he accidentally submits an unreleased extract from his book instead! Disaster! Or maybe not…? Faced with Iro’s unconventional application, Baek Ho-ryung, the dashing CEO of Beus drinks company, is intrigued. But once Iro joins Beus, will his office life begin to emulate his steamy writing…?

(Source: Lezhin)

128830.description:
Oyamada has the top grades in his first year class but is hopelessly in love with the second year's bad boy Musashi Kido. Ever since Musashi saved him from a group of bullies, Oyamada hasn't been able to keep Musashi's broad back out of his mind. Having entered the same high school as him, Oyamada persistently tries to become Musashi's pupil. One day, he decides to follow Musashi after school to learn his secrets... as a house-husband?!

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ヤンキームサシさんと小山田の危険な純情

128831.description:
Amari, now an established manga artist, is in a complicated relationship with Ugo, his former senior in the previous place he worked in. If anything, their relationship ended as quickly as it started. Amari never really understood Ugo back even when he was still Ugo's assistant, which brings him in a confusing dilemma on how and where they even stand in the first place. Meanwhile, Ugo tries to distance himself from Amari and keep their relationship casual due to certain reasons. But it seems both of them can't really reign in those feelings well...

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

128832.description:
Homare is a buyer of family-friendly products who loses a potential client when they hear a rumor he's gay. Feeling frustrated, he stops by a bar on his way home and meets an attractive man named Junpei. Taking a seat next to Junpei at the counter, Homare starts to talk about work and confesses that he's gay. Not only is he accepted warmly, but he discovers that Junpei is also gay... but both of them have a deep fear of emotional commitment. As they grow closer to one another, will fear get in the way of finding true happiness in love? This is a tender and sensual story of how to give love and how to be loved in return.

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

128833.description:
The dark days of one's life, the meeting that will become their light is waiting!

A man who has no regrets about his life, Hyung-Jong, and a woman who is excited about her new life. On one Wednesday, while walking down their own paths, the two meet each other like it's their fate. What will happen to them? Let their lives meet on Wednesday.

To Koitaro, who has grown up to be a zumo wrestler, a rude and fat Otaku guy joins as his brother. Meanwhile Ouko joins same list with Koitaro.

128838.description:
The story of three mothers who send their sons to prestigious middle school.

All of the children are on the verge of failing due to poor grades.

Husband made a woman out and left the house. You may be obsessed with company affairs.

While revealing each other's feelings little by little, Sanyo's life soon begins to mix. As mothers, wives, and active "women", What would you do when you stand at each crossroads?

Can the heart's budding thoughts come true? How will the children, the husbands and the new men who they meet will react? What will the mothers in love do?

128839.description:
"It's impossible between girls!" proclaimed the popular JK Marika Sakakibara.
That was when the cool beauty Fuwa Aya hit her with a million-yen offer.

"I'll pay you 10,000-yen a day for a hundred days, to convince you that you can fall in love with a girl."
"Huh? What!"

Confident that she would never fall for a girl, Marika agreed to the offer. Now every day after school, Marika goes over to Aya's house for some hand-holding, headpats, and maybe even some XX…?

Life at school was going on as usual… until one day Haruma's super popular little sister confesses to me out of the blue?! Though she later clarifies that her feelings toward me are anything but romantic and that she has an ulterior motive, I end up accepting my new role as ‘fake boyfriend’ as a favor to Haruma.
